reviewNote: Every band below is a Netify methodology assumption requiring sign-off by Robert Sturt and Harry Yelland before production. Bands are deliberately wide: the estimator communicates order of magnitude and cost-driver shape, never a quote.
disclaimer: Indicative bands from the Netify SASE Methodology v2026.1 calibration, not vendor quotes.

baseNetworking.basis: Blended SD-WAN-as-component and access licensing per user per month across observed market range at list, mid-scale.

sse-only.basis: SWG, CASB, ZTNA core bundle per user per month.

full-sase.basis: SSE plus SD-WAN component, FWaaS and unified policy per user per month.

full-sase-plus-advanced.basis: Full SASE plus DLP, DEM and advanced threat, commonly premium-tier.

volumeMultiplierByUsers.basis: Sub-500 seats rarely reach programme pricing; narrow negotiation spread, market spread carried in per-user bands.

perSiteMonthly.basis: Edge device amortisation, site licence and site-level support per site per month; excludes underlay circuits.

additionalRegionLoadingPct.basis: PoP spread, data residency handling and regional support loading applied to the licence and site subtotal.

bandwidthLoadingPct.basis: Traffic-linked exposure (overage, bursts) as a share of subtotal; DIY carries the monitoring burden so holds the widest exposure.

managed.basis: Single accountable managed service running networking and security end to end.

co-managed.basis: Provider runs infrastructure, buyer keeps policy control.

diy.basis: No external management fee. Internal 24x7 NOC and SOC staffing cost is real but out of scope for an external-spend estimate.
diy.internalOpsNote: DIY figures exclude internal staffing, which is typically the largest DIY cost.

managed.basis: Onboarding partly bundled into the managed service.

diy.basis: Self-run discovery, policy migration and phased rollout commonly overrun.

implementationOneOff.basis: Discovery, identity integration, policy migration and phased rollout, charged once and amortised over the contract term for the monthly view.

managed.basis: Log retention, overage and renewal uplift exposure; managed contracts bundle more upfront.

termMultiplier.basis: Multi-year commitment discount range applied to recurring charges.

rounding.basis: Bands are rounded so output never implies quote-level precision.
